cards.name: Volleyball Clinics
cards.description: Girls and boys practice and improve volleyball skills in a skill-development clinic.
cards.review_notes: The general Youth Athletics page lists summer clinics, grades 3–8 and $50, but does not print a year or a summer clinic venue. RecDesk also contains fall clinics and older spring clinics; their dates and hours were not transferred to the summer offering. Confirm that the undated $50 fee applies to summer 2026.

cards.name: Sandlot
cards.description: Children practice basic t-ball fielding, hitting and game-like scenario skills. The program meets once a week for four weeks.
cards.review_notes: The general page does not identify a year and has contradictory capacity wording; capacity was omitted. RecDesk's Cashiers Sandlot snippet states July 8, Wednesdays in July, 5:30–6:30 p.m., but no explicit year was readable, so those dates and hours were omitted. RecDesk detail pages opened with no readable body. Mark Watson Park's address is published in the county's 2025 Senior Games packet. Site rows could not be constructed because season dates were unconfirmed. The $25 fee comes from the undated general page and was not applied to Cashiers.

cards.name: Kids Learn to Fish Day
cards.description: Children participate in casting and big-fish contests and have an opportunity to catch trout from Cullowhee Creek.
cards.review_notes: The official Special Events search result states the first Saturday in June and registration in May, without a year. No calendar dates or registration milestone were inferred from that recurring pattern. The page names Cullowhee Creek as the fishing location but does not establish a drop-off venue or street address. The free price is undated current fallback information.
